changelogversion.changelogtext: Added Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II
Added gamepad shift buttons: hold one for a second set of button bindings
Added 'Faster loading from storage folder' option to the launcher settings
Added Sigma Touch to the Other apps screen
TFE: Fixed the game sometimes quitting or showing errors on the first start after installing or updating
TFE: Fixed black screen after leaving and returning to the game on PowerVR devices
TFE: Forcing GLES 2.0 no longer resets the renderer setting to Software
OpenJK: Fixed a column of garbage pixels at the right edge at some resolutions
OpenJK: Fixed crash when loading a level at reduced resolution on PowerVR devices
Fixed the launcher sometimes crashing when returning from a game
Fixed gamepad settings sometimes not working when opened from in-game
Fixed oversized engine icons in the launcher
Improved reliability of games stored in the storage folder
Now requires Android 5.0 or newer
Updated to NDK 27
Added custom resolutions + maintain aspect to OpenJK
Added Run toggle to TFE
Added option to use 'JA' or 'JAMP' folder for JA Multiplayer
Fixed TFE inventory icons
Added cg_dynamicCrosshair option for OpenJK
Added version checking
Increased gamepad sensitivity
Fixed music when using OpenAL in OpenJK
Fixed CUSTOM buttons for both games
Fixed gamepad
Fixed Launcher game titles and icons
Fixed log writer
UI fixes
Added map button to TFE
Added map multitouch control to TFE map
Fixed JK shadows
Fixed TFE inventory (still missing icons)
Fix JA touch screen buttons
Fix TFE blaster with GELS 3.0
Fixed TFE rendering PowerVR
Fixed up Engine options for TFE and OpenJK
Fixed load mods
Fixed secondary storage
